youtube.baslik: Will a cochlear implant's internal unit still work after ten years? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Manufacturers report device reliability as a cumulative survival rate based on an international consensus; the ten-year rates reported for current internal units are usually above 95 percent, and values vary by model. Failure is rare, but in a device used for many years it is always a possibility; a blow to the head is a common cause of internal unit damage.
